summary: 3DNow! 4-component vector-matrix transform (__stdcall). Reads the two packed input quads a2[0], a2[1] (four floats), duplicates each lane with punpckldq/punpckhdq into v4/v6 (from a2[0]) and v7/v8 (from a2[1]), then accumulates the full 4x4 product against the coefficient matrix a3[0..7]: a1[0] = a3[0]*v4 + a3[2]*v6 + a3[4]*v7 + a3[6]*v8 and a1[1] = a3[1]*v4 + a3[3]*v6 + a3[5]*v7 + a3[7]*v8 (nested pfmul/pfadd). Writes both output slots a1[0], a1[1], emits _m_femms() at entry and exit, and returns a1. Unlike F_4DVectorTransform (00526550) there is no reciprocal/w-divide step, so this is the pure matrix multiply form. No guards, no callees.

operations.description: Emit _m_femms() at function entry and again before return to exit MMX/3DNow state.

Load both packed input quads: m64_u64 = a2[0] and v5 = a2[1], then duplicate each component into paired lanes: v4 = punpckldq(a2[0],a2[0]), v6 = punpckhdq(a2[0],a2[0]), v7 = punpckldq(v5,v5), v8 = punpckhdq(v5,v5).

Accumulate the first output quad a1[0] = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[0]), pfmul(v6, a3[2])), pfadd(pfmul(v7, a3[4]), pfmul(v8, a3[6]))): each of the four input components times its matrix column (columns 0, 2, 4, 6).
Accumulate the second output quad v9 = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[1]), pfmul(v6, a3[3])), pfadd(pfmul(v7, a3[5]), pfmul(v8, a3[7]))): the remaining four matrix columns.
Store both results into the output buffer: a1[0] = computed first quad and a1[1] = v9.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.
